notes: The site lists only two locations: Regal Row (1499 Regal Row, Dallas; pick-up and delivery only, open 11am–3pm) and Mustang Station (Bee St, Farmers Branch). The SMU location at 6501 Hillcrest Ave is not mentioned anywhere, so it may be closed or relocated. The happy hour is posted two ways: Mon–Fri 2–6 PM on the happy-hour page and 2PM–6PM every day on the homepage. It offers $5 well cocktails, $7 adult juice pouches, $8 frozen drinks and $5 wings. It most likely applies to the Mustang Station bar in Farmers Branch, since Regal Row is pick-up only and closes at 3pm. No deals were assigned to the SMU location.
